framework_labels: MITRE ATT&CK | T1486 | Data Encrypted for Impact
retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
RANSOMWARE

DESCRIPTION:
Ransomware is a type of malware that encrypts files, systems, or entire environments and demands payment in exchange for decryption keys. Modern ransomware groups often perform double extortion by stealing sensitive data before encryption and threatening public release if payment is not made.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1486 | Data Encrypted for Impact

INDICATORS:
- Files suddenly become inaccessible
- New file extensions appear
- Ransom notes on systems
- Security tools disabled
- Large-scale file modifications
- Unexpected administrative activity
- Lateral movement across systems

DETECTION RULES:
- Mass file modifications
- Unexpected encryption processes
- Ransom note creation
- Security service termination

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Endpoints
- File servers
- Domain controllers
- Backup systems
title: RANSOMWARE
